intro: A Vial of Innocent Blood is a grim alchemical reagent gathered by Syndicate shadow mages lurking in the ruins of Durnholde Keep. Sought after by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill, it serves as a key catalyst in brewing experimental toxins.

p: Within the crumbled walls of Durnholde Keep, the fallen human nobles of the Syndicate practice dark and unsavory arts. Among them are shadow mages who systematically harvest the blood of innocents for their own occult rituals. This macabre practice has drawn the keen attention of Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. Needing untainted blood to brew an experimental pacifying agent meant to neutralize the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains, the Forsaken apothecary sees the Syndicate's grim stores as a convenient shortcut for his work.
